from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Metadata for one judgment document extracted from the collection."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title as it appears in the source")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action explicitly stated in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Broad document category: civil, criminal, administrative, etc.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
